info.title: API-DocTest-List Airline Flights Baggages-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the baggage information associated with airline flights. It allows users to retrieve details about the baggage for specific flights, facilitating better planning and management for airlines and travelers alike. Typical consumers of this API include airline staff, airport personnel, and travel management systems looking to enhance the passenger experience by providing real-time baggage updates. By integrating this functionality, users can ensure smoother travel logistics and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access baggage information associated with flights. You can use this to check the status and details of baggage for specific flights.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information for flights. This body contains specifications regarding the baggage details requested and is essential for the API to return accurate baggage-related data.
